_comment: Routing config only — endpoint, model id, reasoning effort, profile membership. Carries NO quality scores: a stale ranking is worse than none. Availability is MEASURED by `review.py --list`, which probes each provider live; a key being set is not availability. Prices in _cost are per million tokens as listed 2026-08-25 and are a budgeting hint, not a routing input.

_profiles.fast: Every change, while working. ~1-3 min, ~$0.03. Two cheap independent readers.
_profiles.standard: Default. Adds a mid-tier third opinion. ~3-5 min, ~$0.10.
_profiles.deep: Before a push, a release, or anything load-bearing. Adds Sol at xhigh, which found both false-pass bugs the cheaper models missed. ~5-12 min, ~$0.25.

reviewers.name: deepseek-v4-pro
reviewers._note: Best value observed: $0.018/finding over 3 rounds, and found the CRITICAL config-error defect. Always on.

reviewers.name: luna
reviewers._note: Cheapest frontier-tier reader available here — 15x under kimi-k3 per token. Replaces kimi-k3 in the default panel.

reviewers.name: kimi-k2.7-code
reviewers._note: heavy reasoner: at the 16000 default it spent the entire output budget on reasoning tokens and returned EMPTY content with finish_reason=length, which read as an unavailable reviewer for a whole session

reviewers.name: sol
reviewers._note: Slowest (~300s) and dearest, but found BOTH false-pass defects nothing else caught. Worth it before a push; wasteful during iteration.
